storage: append-only JSONL day-files under <archive>/finrashortvol/, one file per TRADE date (gz after 2 days)
written_by: server/finraShortVolume.ts archiveShortVolDay (6h poll, 7-day lookback newest-first, eager boot)
source: FINRA Reg SHO daily consolidated short sale volume (CNMS file, cdn.finra.org/equity/regsho/daily) — keyless; ~12.2K symbols/trading day; weekend/holiday URLs 403 = not published (valid). Format verified live 2026-07-05
license: FINRA publishes these files for free use with attribution; attribution 'FINRA Reg SHO daily short sale volume'
attribution: FINRA Reg SHO daily short sale volume

field_map.date (trade date) — file-level dedup key: the CNMS file is atomic and final once published; dedup is DATE-level by design (per-row keys at 12K/day would waste RSS). If FINRA reposts a corrected file we keep the first capture — noted honestly
field_map.symbol/market: as published (market = comma-joined FINRA facility codes, e.g. B,Q,N)
field_map.short_vol/short_exempt_vol/total_vol: fractional share counts as published (FINRA includes fractional executions)
field_map.trailer integrity: the file's bare row-count trailer must equal parsed rows or the whole file is refused — truncated downloads never reach the archive

confidence_model: RAW official venue data (TRF/ADF short-marked volume). NOT total short interest — this is daily short-marked EXECUTION volume, a flow proxy; the route and any UI must not label it 'short interest'. Derived short_ratio views state their selection floor (total_vol >= 500K) and cap (top 30) explicitly.
cadence: daily trading-day file, published evenings ET; 6h poll makes off-hours a dedup no-op
_note: Universal archive envelope (approved 2026-07-04). BUILD ORDER 5 #1; hypothesis (small-cap short-ratio extremes x 13F/Form4 joins) stays gate-locked — archive + RAW display only.
